page.layout: Top: woodcut ornamental border (decorative, no text). Then full-width dedication block, centred lines in mixed roman/italic with heading-like display. Below: a centred title line "WENCESLAVS MORKOVVSKI de ZASTRISELL Iunior." and "S. P. D.". Then body text in two-column-like initial-letter paragraph; the body is a single column of running text, with an ornamented initial M. Page number "2" with asterisk signature at foot right.

main_text.l: ac Patri suo observando. NEC NON
se se illius se doctrinę penitus

page.notes: Woodcut border at top and decorated initial M are not transcribed. The dedication lines are display type with mixed italic and capitals; the word "Magno" at the start of the body is printed "Agno" and the initial letter is a large woodcut M; the first body word is read as "Agno" with the initial M joined. Line "ledérent" is as printed (initial letter damaged). Some words in the body are uncertain: "opificce" and "ledérent" may be misprints.
